description: This file defines the MarkerCluster class for managing clusters of map markers in Leaflet, including methods for clustering, bounds calculation, and recursive map operations.

classes.name: MarkerCluster
classes.description: A class for clustering map markers with methods for managing child markers and clusters, calculating bounds, and handling map animations.

methods.name: getAllChildMarkers
methods.description: Recursively retrieves all child markers within the cluster.

methods.name: getChildCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of child markers in the cluster.

methods.name: zoomToBounds
methods.description: Adjusts the map view to show all markers within the cluster bounds.

methods.name: _addChild
methods.description: Adds a marker or cluster as a child to this cluster.

methods.name: _recalculateBounds
methods.description: Recalculates the geographical bounds of the cluster based on its children.
